text: In July 2016, City Council approved (2016.TE17.6) re-zoning for a new hotel at 49-51 Camden Street, on the south-east corner of the intersection of Camden Street and Brant Street. It is currently under construction. Hotel uses tend to be associated with relatively high passenger pick-up and drop-off activity including taxi traffic. While the Official Plan requires that large developments of this nature accommodate these activities on site, City staff determined that it would not be feasible in this case due to the small size of the redevelopment site. To accommodate standing taxis and the pick-up and drop-off activity associated with the hotel, the developer proposed to construct a layby on Brant Street.
